title: Across the Thread Boundary: What a Queued Connection Actually Does
fallback: This phase is where Qt stops being optional, and this lesson in particular is about a Qt mechanism with no counterpart outside it. Run rcpp doctor for the install command. The problem it solves is the one lesson 07-01 measured, and the lock free queue from 07-02 is the shape underneath Qt's answer, so a learner without Qt has already met the idea in the form that needs no library.
